example.title: Relf Building (1901), Water Street (John Margolies Roadside America photo)

brief: Narrow three-storey red-brick front: three round-arched second-floor windows with stone keystones, and on the third floor a big projecting galvanized-metal oriel (four arched sashes, name panel on the base) under an elaborate pressed-metal parapet with pedimented crest, pinnacles and rosettes, painted grey-blue and white. Ground floor is a clean plate-glass storefront with a centre door and gold window lettering; a lower two-storey brick neighbour with a bracketed hip roof makes up the rest of the lot.
